snippet.title: Just a Piece — Official Announcement Trailer | Cozy Puzzle Game
snippet.description:
Introducing Just a Piece, the first game from WANDERLOOM!

Just a Piece is a cozy puzzle game where you rotate, flip, and arrange pieces to solve puzzles and bring little worlds to life.

- 50 handcrafted puzzles
- 10 unique worlds to discover
- Rotate and flip pieces to find solutions
- A relaxing atmosphere to enjoy at your own pace

🎮 Coming Soon to Steam!

💚 Wishlist Just a Piece:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5342700/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=announcement_trailer

Developed by WANDERLOOM, a solo indie game studio.

Small journeys, great moments.

#JustAPiece #CozyGames #PuzzleGame
